lines.text: GTA Six might make a billion dollars before you can even play it.
In 2013, GTA Five made eight hundred million on day one, and passed a billion by day three.
At the time, the fastest any entertainment product had ever hit a billion.
GTA Six? Sensor Tower estimates more than a billion in digital pre-orders, with three days still to go.
Take-Two hasn't confirmed it. Your copy unlocks November nineteenth.
